import base
extend base.get("db", db, key) = "db:" + key

import base
extend base.get("cache", c, key) = "cache:" + key

import base
extend base.get("db", db, key) = "db2:" + key

import db_ext
import db_ext2
use get from base with db_ext, db_ext2
get("db", 1, "k")
